scope: geometry-only postprocess of all sealed source-class/current-slot conditional baseline domains; no integer acceptance or fault reclassification

domain.raw_budget: the existing saved expanded_raw_threshold minus fixed-integer GLS residual cost
domain.component_covers: exact horizontal projection ellipse necessary cover intersect 3D outer-ball / exact-length sphere-cap cover intersect original class cover
domain.exception_rule: retain original compatible cover and mark new geometry unqualified; never delete on exception
domain.empty_rule: separately report numerical necessary-domain empty; do not relabel physical fault or accept another integer
domain.quality_rule: original row and per-class quality retained even if geometry eliminates a class; bad phase is never a geometry input or pruning reason

metrics: all 60 slot identities and all 115 class rows
original/new classwise component union width and enclosing hull width
number and identities of additional geometry-empty classes
retained class count and disconnected components
width summaries stratified by unchanged original quality/single-vs-multi
stop_rules: Input, registration, source-pin or ordered slot/class-count mismatch stops before mathematical processing.
One pass only; no replacement windows, threshold changes or retries.
Numerical kernel exception retains old cover and is reported unqualified; all remaining registered classes still processed once.
No downstream measurement, integer acceptance, fault release or navigation is authorized by this plan.
limits: Necessary outer covers can remain broad or nonempty even when exact ellipsoid/sphere intersection is empty.
Guarded floating-point calculations are not interval-arithmetic certificates.
Source-set completeness remains conditional on original selected-observation likelihood and physical arc lineage.
No physical coverage probability, false-fix probability or end-to-end latency is established.
